rules.statement: A prescriptive title can be claimed if the respondent has been in possession of the land for a period of well over ten years prior to the filing of this action, adverse to the rights of the plaintiff.
rules.supporting_quote: In the circumstances, it is abundantly clear that the respondent had been in possession of the land claimed by the plaintiff for a period of well over ten years prior to the filing of this action on 03.05.1991, adverse to the rights of the plaintiff which is the criteria applicable to claim prescriptive title in terms of Section 3 of the Prescription Ordinance.
